title: SHUCKED
seo_title: SHUCKED at Hammons Hall in Springfield, MO
description: SHUCKED is a Broadway musical comedy about Maizy and Beau's wedding, a dying cornfield that protects their small community, and a con artist in Cob County. It is recommended for ages 10+ and contains adult themes, some adult language and corny innuendo. It runs Tuesday, January 19 through Thursday, January 21, 2027, starting at 7:30 PM, at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
